copy.tagline: 构建、安装并测试 easyskillz CLI 的完整 QA 流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发或维护 easyskillz CLI 并需要自动化 QA。
copy.tagline_en: Build, install locally, and test all flows for easyskillz CLI QA
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop or maintain easyskillz CLI and need automated QA.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动构建 easyskillz 包，在临时环境中安装，并运行所有命令流程的测试，最后生成一份 QA 报告。
howto.when: 当你对 easyskillz 项目做了更改、准备发布新版本、重构或添加新功能后，要求 Claude 运行 QA 流程时触发。

say.text: 运行 easyskillz-qa 技能，给我一份完整报告。
say.note: Claude 会执行所有测试并输出报告。

say.text: 检查 easyskillz 的 skill 管理流程是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会测试添加、列出、停用、激活和删除技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically build the easyskillz package, install it in a temporary environment, run all command flow tests, and generate a QA report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to run the QA workflow after making changes to easyskillz, before publishing a new version, after refactoring, or when investigating bugs.

say_en.text: Run the easyskillz-qa skill and give me a full report.
say_en.note: Claude will execute all tests and output a report.

say_en.text: Check if the easyskillz skill management flow works.
say_en.note: Claude will test adding, listing, deactivating, activating, and removing skills.
